Each helper negative expects ValidationError and the specific diagnostic. The helper positive controls and full valid CLI runs establish that rejection is not caused by a universally broken validator.

Header tampering is checked to preserve decompressed bytes before testing artifact-identity rejection.

The actual-operand-byte CLI mutation tests outer compressed identity. It does not isolate the decoded-SHA CLI check; direct decode unit tests and the independent tamper suite exercise decoded payload integrity.
